# Medindia

> Medindia is India's trusted health & wellness portal offering 600K+ medical resources, expert interviews, disease information, and health calculators across multiple languages.

Medindia is a HONCode-certified health information platform based in Chennai, India, serving South Asia with comprehensive medical content, telemedicine resources, and patient engagement tools. The platform combines medical expertise with multilingual accessibility and technology-driven health solutions.

## Key Topics

- Health & Wellness
- Medical News
- Disease Information
- Online Consultation
- Telemedicine
- Health Calculators
- Medical Education
- Healthcare Professionals
- Patient Engagement
- Medical Conditions
- Health Articles
- Healthcare Summit
- HONCode Certification
- South Asia
- Health Tips

## Core Platform

- [Medindia - Your Trusted Source for Health & Wellness](https://www.medindia.net/index.htm): Homepage: Medindia's main health & wellness portal with 600K+ resources
- [About Medindia](https://www.medindia.net/about.asp): About page: Medindia's mission, history & HONCode-certified authority
- [Editorial Board](https://www.medindia.net/medical-review-team.asp): Editorial Board: Medical experts & reviewers ensuring content accuracy

## Medical Content & Resources

- [Health Centers](https://www.medindia.net/health/centers/index.htm): Health Centers: Disease directory with articles on ADHD, AIDS/HIV, Alzheimer's
- [Health Calculators](https://es.medindia.net/patients/calculators/index.asp): Spanish health calculators for blood pressure, pregnancy & nutrition
- [Expert Interviews & In-Depth Reports](https://www.medindia.net/interviews/index.asp): Expert interviews with doctors on surgery, dental & wellness topics

## News & Insights

- [Medindia in the News](https://www.medindia.net/press_reports/index.asp): Press releases & recognition from Healthcare Summit 2024
- [Weekly Health & Wellness Newsletters](https://www.medindia.net/e-newsletter/empowering-better-health/index.htm): Weekly newsletter: Healthcare trends, quizzes & wellness content

## Multilingual Access

- [Hindi Health Portal](https://hi.medindia.net/index.asp): Hindi language health portal with disease info & health calculators

## User Support & Registration

- [Benefits of Registration](https://www.medindia.net/regis/registration-benefits.asp): Registration benefits: health records, consultations & wellness ebooks
- [Contact Us](https://www.medindia.net/contact.asp): Contact information for Medindia4u.com Pvt. Ltd. in Chennai
- [Feedback](https://www.medindia.net/feedback.asp): Feedback form for user support, bug reporting & suggestions

## Business & Partnerships

- [Advertising on Medindia](https://www.medindia.net/advertisement.asp): Advertising opportunities & media kit for health marketing campaigns
